name: hooks-worktrunk
description: Enforces Worktrunk as the worktree-management interface for Claude and Codex. A cross-runtime PreToolUse guard denies direct git worktree and gh pr checkout commands with the equivalent wt command, a PreToolUse:Agent guard denies harness isolation:"worktree" in favor of a parent-prepared checkout, and Claude-only WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove handlers route the native worktree lifecycle through wt. Steering and config templates cover official plugins, agent checkout isolation, lifecycle hook ownership, repository-scoped build targets, copy-ignored warm starts, deterministic dev-server ports, aliases, and LLM commit generation.
